summary: Lawrence explicitly called Israel's war in Gaza a genocide at a June 2026 community forum and made that opposition, alongside calls to stop arms sales to Israel, a core element of his MI-7 campaign. His platform calls for stopping arms sales to Israel and ending the war on Iran. Vote for Peace rated him an Ally in the general election, and he ran against opponents he described as being in the pocket of the pro-war lobby.
